gaps.issue_en: The recommended operating point (263 mL/min at TMP 0.30 bar) was never used in a run. Runs fed about 300 to 390 mL/min (about 305 in the sampling record) at a mean TMP near 0.03 bar. TMP reached 0.16 bar only for 60 s with the pinch valve closed. The 313 mL/min row of the window table is already marked not recommended.
gaps.issue_zh: 建議的操作點（263 mL/min、TMP 0.30 bar）從未用於實際運轉。實際進料約 300 至 390 mL/min（取樣紀錄中約 305），平均 TMP 約 0.03 bar；只有夾管閥關閉的 60 秒 TMP 才到 0.16 bar。操作窗口表中 313 mL/min 那一列本身就標示為不建議。
gaps.say_en: We set 263 mL/min and 0.30 bar from calibration with water, but our culture runs fed about 300 to 390 mL/min at a TMP near 0.03 bar. So the operating point is a recommendation we have not yet run at.
gaps.say_zh: 263 mL/min 和 0.30 bar 是用水校正得出的建議值，但我們的培養運轉進料約 300 至 390 mL/min，TMP 約 0.03 bar。所以這個操作點是我們還沒有實際跑過的建議值。

gaps.issue_en: Design flux is 2 LMH on Biomanufacturing (J/Jcrit 0.04, threshold 46 LMH), but the Digital Twin runs drew 24 mL/min (72 LMH), 12 mL/min (36 LMH) and 17 mL/min (51 LMH) through 200 cm². Run 5 at 72 and run 7 at 51 are above the 46 LMH threshold. The 0.04 describes the design, not the runs. Medium draw of 0.96 L/day also assumes 2 LMH.
gaps.issue_zh: 生物製造頁的設計通量是 2 LMH（J/Jcrit 0.04、門檻 46 LMH），但數位孿生記錄的運轉在 200 cm² 上抽 24 mL/min（72 LMH）、12 mL/min（36 LMH）、17 mL/min（51 LMH）。第 5 次的 72 與第 7 次的 51 高於 46 LMH 門檻。0.04 描述的是設計值，不是實際運轉；每日培養基 0.96 L 也是以 2 LMH 計。
gaps.where: biomanufacturing#Critical flux and the fouling margin, #Scaling; software#Every run so far
gaps.say_en: Our scaling table uses 2 LMH, but we actually ran 36 to 72 LMH, and our fouling model puts the limit at 46. The fouling trend we saw was mild, 1.9 to 4.4 kPa in 77 hours, but that is one module in one run.
gaps.say_zh: 我們的擴大規模表用 2 LMH，但實際跑的是 36 至 72 LMH，而我們的積垢模型把上限放在 46。我們看到的積垢趨勢不大，77 小時內從 1.9 升到 4.4 kPa，但那只是一個模組、一次運轉。

gaps.issue_en: DNPH activity units disagree by about 1000 times: 0.037 mU/mL at 18 h on the bioreactor page against about 30 nmol α-KB per mL per hour (about 30 mU/mL) on Results. Only the Results figure fits the stated specific activity of 2.3 to 8.3 U/mg. Development converts 30.9 nmol/mL/h to 0.52 mU/mL with a per-minute unit, a third convention.
gaps.issue_zh: DNPH 活性單位相差約一千倍：反應器頁 18 小時為 0.037 mU/mL，結果頁約 30 nmol α-KB/mL/h（約 30 mU/mL）。只有結果頁的數字符合所寫的比活性 2.3 至 8.3 U/mg。開發頁把 30.9 nmol/mL/h 換成 0.52 mU/mL，用的是每分鐘的單位，是第三種算法。
gaps.where: hardware-bioreactor#5.2; results#Product in the permeate; development#Demonstrate that the secreted enzyme is active
gaps.say_en: The 0.037 mU/mL on the bioreactor page is about a thousand times below the roughly 30 nmol per mL per hour on Results, and only the Results value gives the 2.3 to 8.3 U/mg we state. I would state the unit definition first before quoting any activity.
gaps.say_zh: 反應器頁的 0.037 mU/mL 比結果頁約 30 nmol/mL/h 小約一千倍，只有結果頁的值才能得到我們所寫的 2.3 至 8.3 U/mg。我會先說明單位定義，再報活性數字。

gaps.issue_en: Net membrane pressure drop at 263 mL/min is 0.084 bar (0.90 times theory) on the bioreactor page but 0.096 bar (1.03 times) on Digital Twin, Biomanufacturing and Development, both from the 16 August series. Module geometry also has two versions: 200 cm² and 11 fibers (rig, manual) against 150 cm² and 8 fibers (vendor reference on Results; the Biomanufacturing shear table).
gaps.issue_zh: 263 mL/min 時模組淨壓降，反應器頁是 0.084 bar（理論的 0.90 倍），數位孿生、生物製造與開發頁是 0.096 bar（1.03 倍），都來自 8 月 16 日那組實驗。模組規格也有兩種版本：200 cm²、11 根纖維（實驗台、手冊）對 150 cm²、8 根纖維（結果頁的廠商參考、生物製造頁的剪切表）。
gaps.where: hardware-bioreactor#4.1 DBTL 3; software#Module pressure drop; development; biomanufacturing#Where the geometry comes from; results#References
gaps.say_en: We have two values for the net module pressure drop at 263 mL/min, 0.084 and 0.096 bar, and both are close to theory. The vendor reference lists 150 cm² and 8 fibers, but the bench check supports 11 fibers and 200 cm², which is what we use.
gaps.say_zh: 263 mL/min 時模組淨壓降我們有兩個數值，0.084 和 0.096 bar，兩者都接近理論值。廠商參考資料寫 150 cm²、8 根纖維，但實驗台的檢查支持 11 根、200 cm²，這也是我們採用的。

gaps.issue_en: Containment evidence is two single platings (2 mL on 6 June; a lumen against shell pair after 24 h at 37 °C), with no replicates, no recorded detection limit and no log reduction. Cell width is 0.25 to 1.0 µm on Safety, 0.8 to 2.0 µm on Results, 1 to 2 µm on Development, and the bioreactor page says the pores are smaller than any cell.
gaps.issue_zh: 封閉性證據是兩次單次平板（6 月 6 日取 2 mL；以及 37 °C 培養 24 小時的管腔側對殼側一組），沒有重複、沒有記錄偵測極限、也沒有對數減量。細胞寬度在安全頁是 0.25 至 1.0 µm，結果頁是 0.8 至 2.0 µm，開發頁是 1 至 2 µm，而反應器頁說孔比任何細胞都小。
gaps.where: results#Containment and release; safety-and-security#Primary containment; development#Contain; hardware-bioreactor#9.2.1
gaps.say_en: Our containment evidence is two single platings, with no replicates, no recorded detection limit and no log reduction. Cell width is quoted differently on different pages, so we call retention preliminary, not a measured efficiency.
gaps.say_zh: 我們的封閉性證據是兩次單次平板，沒有重複、沒有記錄偵測極限、也沒有對數減量。各頁對細胞寬度的寫法不同，所以我們稱保留效果只是初步證據，不是量測出的效率。

gaps.issue_en: Safety describes automated TMP alerts, droplet leak detection and shell-side turbulence detection as working. The bioreactor page calls the pressure alarm and droplet sensor planned, and no droplet or turbulence sensor is on the cost list. A 0.70 bar pressure trip is in the firmware (armed in the 77-hour run, peak 0.57 bar, never fired). In integrated run 3 pressure did not catch a real leak: feed pressure rose 0.19 to 0.37 bar while TMP stayed flat.
gaps.issue_zh: 安全頁把自動 TMP 警報、漏液偵測和殼側紊流偵測寫成已在運作。反應器頁則說壓力警報和漏液感測器還在規劃，成本表裡也沒有漏液或紊流感測器。韌體裡有 0.70 bar 的壓力跳脫（77 小時那次運轉待命，最高 0.57 bar，從未動作）。整合第 3 次運轉中壓力沒有抓到真正的漏液：進料壓從 0.19 升到 0.37 bar，TMP 卻沒變。
gaps.where: safety-and-security#Secondary containment; hardware-bioreactor#9.2.1 to 9.2.3; biomanufacturing#Regulation and biosafety; results#Pressure and sampling; engineering
gaps.say_en: A 0.70 bar pressure trip exists in the firmware and was armed but never fired; the droplet sensor and shell-side turbulence detection are not built. In integrated run 3 a real leak raised feed pressure and left TMP flat, so pressure alone did not catch it.
gaps.say_zh: 韌體裡有 0.70 bar 的壓力跳脫，待命但從未動作；漏液感測器和殼側紊流偵測還沒做出來。整合第 3 次運轉的真實漏液讓進料壓上升、TMP 卻沒變，所以光靠壓力沒有抓到。

gaps.issue_en: The leaf sensor was bench-tested in air only, with no leaf. Site offsets were +1.71, +1.31 and +0.47 °C (single runs from −0.09 to +1.86), so the 1.2 to 1.9 °C summary leaves out the +0.47 site. The wetness channel read 0.0% and has never been wetted. Results says the correction needed is −0.2 to +1.8 °C.
gaps.issue_zh: 葉片感測器只在空氣中做過桌上測試，沒有葉片。各地點偏差為 +1.71、+1.31、+0.47 °C（單次從 −0.09 到 +1.86），所以「1.2 至 1.9 °C」的摘要漏掉了 +0.47 的地點。濕度通道讀 0.0%，從未被弄濕。結果頁說需要的校正範圍是 −0.2 至 +1.8 °C。
gaps.where: software#The leaf and air sensors on the bench; results#Field sensors; home
gaps.say_en: The leaf sensor has only been on a bench, in air, with no leaf. Its offset ranged from +0.47 to +1.71 °C by site, so the 1.2 to 1.9 °C summary hides the smallest one, and the wetness channel has never been wetted.
gaps.say_zh: 葉片感測器只在桌上、空氣中、沒有葉片的情況下測過。各地點偏差從 +0.47 到 +1.71 °C，所以「1.2 至 1.9 °C」的摘要把最小的那個地點藏起來了，而且濕度通道從未被弄濕。

gaps.issue_en: The LPA page says the intensity test the array was built for has not been run, yet Results shows Western blots at 2%, 12% and 100% green that did not order by intensity (red at full power was not silent). Light is reported only in lux, never photon flux. Matched groups are only about 3% apart in green (2.33 to 2.40 klux) and under 10% in red, so PWM sets the levels. The first culture run had light leaking between wells.
gaps.issue_zh: LPA 頁面說這個陣列原本要做的強度測試還沒進行，但結果頁有 2%、12%、100% 綠光的 Western blot，且不依強度排序（全功率紅光也不是沒有訊號）。光只用 lux 報告，沒有光子通量。配對後各組綠光只差約 3%（2.33 至 2.40 klux）、紅光不到 10%，所以強度由 PWM 設定。第一次培養運轉有光線在孔間外漏。
gaps.say_en: The LPA intensity test is not done: our Western blots at 2, 12 and 100% green did not order by intensity, and the first culture run had light leaking between wells. Light is in lux only, and the matched groups are only about 3% apart in green, so PWM sets the levels.
gaps.say_zh: LPA 的強度測試還沒完成：2%、12%、100% 綠光的 Western blot 不依強度排序，第一次培養運轉也有光線在孔間外漏。光只用 lux 表示，配對後各組綠光只差約 3%，所以強度由 PWM 設定。

gaps.issue_en: Wavelengths differ by page: Home says 520 nm green and 660 nm red; Hardware, Contribution, Geospatial and Entrepreneurship say about 535 and 670; Results says 525 and 630 and that the red LEDs emit at 640 nm against the 672 nm CcaS needs. The LPA page gives no wavelength, and Development lists verifying the real wavelengths as future work.
gaps.issue_zh: 各頁波長不一：首頁寫綠光 520 nm、紅光 660 nm；硬體、貢獻、地理空間與創業頁寫約 535 和 670；結果頁寫 525 和 630，並說紅光 LED 約 640 nm，而 CcaS 需要 672 nm。LPA 頁面沒有給波長，開發頁把驗證真實波長列為未來工作。
gaps.where: home; hardware-bioreactor#7.1.1; hardware-diopal; contribution; results#What it settles; development#LPA
gaps.say_en: The wiki gives 520 and 660 nm on Home, about 535 and 670 elsewhere, and 525 and 630 on Results, which also says our red LEDs emit at 640 nm. We have not measured the real LED wavelengths, so I would quote them as literature values.
gaps.say_zh: wiki 首頁寫 520 和 660 nm，其他頁約 535 和 670，結果頁寫 525 和 630，並說我們的紅光 LED 約 640 nm。我們沒有量過 LED 的真實波長，所以我會把這些說成文獻數值。

gaps.issue_en: Green light was never fitted to the bioreactor in a working way. Every integrated run used a constitutive promoter, so light control was out of the test. The Digital Twin lists green light as tested, not integrated, and a 3 m green LED strip appears on the rig specification. On the LPA, green and red ELISA values were similar (12.9 and 12.5 µg/mL at 13 h), so light-dependent regulation is unconfirmed.
gaps.issue_zh: 綠光從未以可運作的方式裝進反應器。每次整合運轉都用組成型啟動子，所以光控制不在測試之內。數位孿生把綠光標為「測過但未整合」，規格表則有一條 3 m 綠光 LED 燈帶。在 LPA 上，綠光與紅光的 ELISA 數值相近（13 小時為 12.9 與 12.5 µg/mL），所以光依賴的調控尚未確認。
gaps.where: software#Current limits, #What our digital twin measures; hardware-bioreactor#4.2, #7.1.1; development#Show that green light controls production; biomanufacturing#Abstract
gaps.say_en: Green-light control was tested on the LPA only. Every integrated bioreactor run used a constitutive promoter, and the Digital Twin lists green light as tested, not integrated.
gaps.say_zh: 綠光控制只在 LPA 上測過。每一次整合反應器運轉都用組成型啟動子，數位孿生也把綠光列為「測過但未整合」。

gaps.issue_en: Run records conflict. Integrated run 2 pH: too acidic (bioreactor page) against pH rose (Results). First September run volume: 500 mL (bioreactor, Engineering, Results) against 1 L (Digital Twin); Biomanufacturing says 300 mL before and 1 L since, and 400 mL in its abstract. First Western blot: faint at best against confirmed selective passage. Valve failure: peroxide (bioreactor) against KOH (Engineering) against indistinguishable (Results). Temperature probe never answered and DO probes failed. Three transducers on the rig against four listed live. Pump named BP1000 (1 L/min), ZP4000 (230 to 2600 mL/min), measured up to 1535 mL/min. Run numbers also differ: hardware integrated runs 1 to 4 are Digital Twin runs 4 to 7.
gaps.issue_zh: 運轉紀錄互相矛盾。整合第 2 次 pH：反應器頁說太酸，結果頁說上升。9 月第一次運轉體積：反應器、工程、結果頁寫 500 mL，數位孿生寫 1 L；生物製造頁說先前 300 mL、9 月起 1 L，摘要又寫 400 mL。第一張 Western blot：反應器頁說微弱，結果頁說確認選擇性通過。閥的損壞：反應器頁歸因過氧化氫，工程頁歸因 KOH，結果頁說無法分辨。溫度探頭從未回應、DO 探頭失敗。實驗台三個壓力感測器，卻列了四個運轉中。幫浦寫 BP1000（1 L/min）、ZP4000（230 至 2600 mL/min），實測最高 1535 mL/min。運轉編號也不同：硬體頁整合第 1 至 4 次就是數位孿生的第 4 至 7 次。
gaps.where: hardware-bioreactor#4.2, #7.1.1, #10.1; results#Growth in the reactor, #pH and antibiotic resupply; software#Every run so far, #Current limits; engineering; biomanufacturing
gaps.say_en: Some run details differ between our pages: the pH direction in run 2, the volume of the first September run, how clear the first Western blot was, and what broke the valve. I would state both versions, say which page I trust, and not guess.
gaps.say_zh: 我們的頁面對部分運轉細節說法不同：第 2 次的 pH 方向、9 月第一次運轉的體積、第一張 Western blot 清不清楚，還有是什麼弄壞了閥。我會兩種說法都講，說明我信哪一頁，不亂猜。

gaps.issue_en: Cost: US$1022.67 is known costs only. The controller (UNO Q), mainboard and converter, KOH dosing pump and stir bar are not listed; the pinch-valve nuts and screws are unpriced. The photometer is 36% of it. No comparison with a commercial hollow-fiber system exists; FiberCell appears only as a sourcing note. US$2277 is a planning estimate. Contribution quotes the Pro at US$360.60, the photometer page US$371.78.
gaps.issue_zh: 成本：US$1022.67 只含已知成本。控制器（UNO Q）、主機板與轉換器、KOH 加料幫浦、攪拌子都沒列入，夾管閥螺帽螺絲未標價。光度計佔其中 36%。沒有與商用中空纖維系統的比較；FiberCell 只出現在採購備註。US$2277 是規劃估算。貢獻頁寫 Pro 為 US$360.60，光度計頁寫 US$371.78。
gaps.where: hardware-bioreactor#10.1; entrepreneurship; contribution; drylab-notebook; biomanufacturing#Field Deployment
gaps.say_en: US$1022.67 is the known cost: it leaves out the controller, mainboard, KOH pump and stir bar. We have not compared it with a commercial hollow-fiber system, and the US$2277 in the business plan is a planning estimate, not a quote.
gaps.say_zh: US$1022.67 是已知成本：沒有算控制器、主機板、KOH 幫浦和攪拌子。我們沒有和商用中空纖維系統比較過，商業計畫書的 US$2277 是規劃估算，不是報價。

gaps.issue_en: Hydroponics: the predicted freeboard (4.8 mm at 71.3 g, about 1 mm per 3.5 g) comes from the STL files and was never measured on a printed plate. The CH Bio peptide salt pre-tests ran with one plate per arm, so treatments cannot be ranked, and after several failed plantings the later protectant runs moved to tube racks.
gaps.issue_zh: 水耕：預測的乾舷（71.3 g 時 4.8 mm，每 3.5 g 約 1 mm）來自 STL 檔，從未在實際列印的浮板上量過。CH Bio 胜肽的鹽逆境前測每個處理只有一塊板，無法排出優劣；盒子裡幾次種植失敗後，後來的保護物實驗改用試管架。
gaps.say_en: The plate's 4.8 mm freeboard is a calculation from the print files and has not been measured on a real plate. The salt pre-tests ran with one plate per arm, and the later protectant runs moved to tube racks.
gaps.say_zh: 浮板 4.8 mm 的乾舷是由列印檔算出來的，還沒有在真正的浮板上量過。鹽逆境前測每個處理只有一塊板，後來的保護物實驗就改用試管架。

gaps.issue_en: Shear on the cells: wall shear is about 4060 s⁻¹ at 263 mL/min, but culture viability after circulation at that shear was not read, and cumulative exposure is not established. The one published figure the team found (B. subtilis in Couette flow at up to 1482 s⁻¹) shrank cells to about half size with 9.3-fold more reactive oxygen species, though in a different vessel.
gaps.issue_zh: 細胞承受的剪切：263 mL/min 時管壁剪切率約 4060 s⁻¹，但沒有測過在這個剪切下循環後的細胞存活率，累積暴露量也沒有釐清。團隊找到的唯一已發表數字（枯草桿菌在 Couette 流中最高 1482 s⁻¹）顯示細胞縮小到約一半、活性氧增加 9.3 倍，不過那是不同的容器。
gaps.where: measurement#Flow and pressure monitoring; biomanufacturing#Wall shear and the operating envelope; hardware-bioreactor#4.1 DBTL 3
gaps.say_en: We computed a wall shear of about 4060 s⁻¹ but did not read cell viability after circulating at it. The one published figure we found points the other way, so the safe margin is an expectation, not a measurement.
gaps.say_zh: 我們算出管壁剪切率約 4060 s⁻¹，但沒有測在這個剪切下循環後的細胞存活率。我們找到的唯一已發表數字方向相反，所以安全餘裕只是預期，不是量測結果。
